protocol.signal: All 21 frozen signal arms; default third-plus + saved S7 rally veto + S4 dilution >=25%
protocol.clear_status_policy: E1 displayed offer in every policy, including E0; same edge/clock/volume/cost assumptions
protocol.queue: Eligible chosen-venue buyer prints after acknowledgement consume queue ahead before own quantity. No cancellation credit. Hidden-liquidity uncertainty remains; these are conditional simulations.
protocol.cover: Original signal-anchored 20th session; 90 to 15 minutes before close, same 5/10% causal-flow budget. Unfilled balance retries the next observed session and remains a liability; no final-print completion.
protocol.parent_budget: Freeze floor($100,000 / first valid arrival midpoint) shares; no expansion after decline. Report actual proceeds separately.
protocol.flow: Only regular deduplicated external direct-venue prints; observe before reserving, reserve filled + working + pending-cancel shares. Rolling budget also applies.
protocol.edge: Source-available fixed edge forecast required in archive. No return-based fit or optimal schedule is inferred from the current caches.
protocol.source_policy: Certified source attributes are ingest attestations, not independent proof of simulated fills. No sampled-bar or 50%-capture substitute.
protocol.uncertainty: For complete primary-latency paths compare to matched E0 using issuer bootstrap and six-month calendar blocks, then Holm over 12 comparisons per rule. Missing paths and unresolved exit evidence withhold selection claims.

limitations: The two named reuse indexes and matched prepared files were audited. The raw Databento cache schema directories and flat expansion CSV headers were also inspected; this is not an event-by-event reconstruction of all raw files.
Sampled venue quotes are not certified consolidated NBBO. One-second OHLC volume does not identify aggressor, price-level queue or eligible fills.
Flow-budget dollars are aggregate bounds on recorded venue flow, not estimated fills or obtainable position sizes. No performance is inferred.
No archived usable borrow approval, native route confirmation or complete exact-cohort entry-and-exit replay is established by these caches.
Prepared arrays were hash-inventoried; this audit does not independently revalidate every upstream raw record.
